control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on TX-3001 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-3001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 December 2010 an incident occurred on TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
